title: Materials.
officialText:
Roof signs erected inside the fire districts shall be constructed entirely of noncombustible materials and the
facings of such signs shall be of noncombustible materials, except as permitted by Section H107. Outside of the fire districts, the
structure of roof signs exceeding 65 feet (19 812 mm) in height above grade, or exceeding 1500 square feet (139 m2) in display area,
shall be constructed of noncombustible materials and the facings of such signs shall be of noncombustible materials, except as
permitted by Section H107.
